ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AD=80$, $AB=10$, and $BC=20$, \\
hence, $CD=80-10-20=50$, \\
since $Q$ is the midpoint of $CD$, \\
thus, $CQ=\frac{1}{2}CD=25$, and $AQ=10+20+25=55$, \\
after $t$ seconds, $AP=10+3t$, \\
when $AP=AQ$, $10+3t=55$, \\
therefore, $t=\boxed{15}$, \\
when $AP=AQ$, the value of $t$ is \boxed{15}.
